entries.example: 我的同事信基督教，每週日都去教會。
entries.exampleEnglish: My coworker is a Christian and goes to church every Sunday.
entries.question: 你的國家很多人信基督教嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do many people in your country believe in Christianity?
entries.answer: 對，我的國家很多人信基督教。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, many people in my country are Christian.

entries.example: 聽音樂時，他的頭跟著節奏上下晃動。
entries.exampleEnglish: When he listens to music, his head bobs up and down to the beat.
entries.question: 你聽音樂時，頭會上下晃動嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you listen to music, does your head bob up and down?
entries.answer: 會，聽到喜歡的歌，我的頭會上下晃動。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when I hear a song I like, my head bobs up and down.

entries.example: 但願明天不要下雨，我們要去爬山。
entries.exampleEnglish: Hopefully it won't rain tomorrow; we're going hiking.
entries.question: 你對明年有什麼願望？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you wish for next year?
entries.answer: 但願明年工作順利，身體健康。
entries.answerEnglish: I hope work goes well next year and I stay healthy.

entries.example: 我的中文老師常常鼓勵我多開口。
entries.exampleEnglish: My Chinese teacher often encourages me to speak up more.
entries.question: 學中文時，誰最常鼓勵你？
entries.questionEnglish: Who encourages you the most when you're learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 我的台灣朋友最常鼓勵我。
entries.answerEnglish: My Taiwanese friends encourage me the most.

entries.example: 這台筆電的處理器很快，跑遊戲很順。
entries.exampleEnglish: This laptop's processor is fast, so games run smoothly.
entries.question: 你買電腦時會注意處理器嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you pay attention to the processor when you buy a computer?
entries.answer: 會，我一定會先看處理器夠不夠快。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always check first whether the processor is fast enough.

entries.example: 計程車上的計費表跳得好快。
entries.exampleEnglish: The meter in the taxi is going up really fast.
entries.question: 坐計程車時，你會一直看計費表嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you take a taxi, do you keep looking at the meter?
entries.answer: 會，塞車的時候我會一直看計費表。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when there's traffic I keep watching the meter.

entries.example: 這兩張帳單合計三千塊。
entries.exampleEnglish: These two bills add up to three thousand dollars.
entries.question: 你每個月的房租和水電合計多少？
entries.questionEnglish: How much do your rent and utilities come to each month?
entries.answer: 房租和水電合計大概兩萬塊。
entries.answerEnglish: Rent and utilities come to about twenty thousand altogether.

entries.example: 外面的建築工人一大早就開始工作了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The builders outside started working first thing in the morning.
entries.question: 你覺得建築工人的工作辛苦嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think construction workers have a hard job?
entries.answer: 很辛苦，建築工人常常在大太陽下工作。
entries.answerEnglish: Very hard. Builders often work under the blazing sun.

entries.example: 是嗎？我不知道他結婚了。
entries.exampleEnglish: Really? I didn't know he got married.
entries.question: 朋友說了奇怪的事，你會說什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: When a friend says something surprising, what do you say?
entries.answer: 我會說：「是嗎？真的假的？」
entries.answerEnglish: I'd say, "Really? Are you serious?"

entries.example: 炸的東西膽固醇很高，不要吃太多。
entries.exampleEnglish: Fried food is high in cholesterol, so don't eat too much.
entries.question: 哪些食物的膽固醇比較高？
entries.questionEnglish: Which foods are higher in cholesterol?
entries.answer: 蛋黃和內臟的膽固醇比較高。
entries.answerEnglish: Egg yolks and organ meats are higher in cholesterol.

entries.example: 我表哥在陸軍當中士。
entries.exampleEnglish: My cousin is a sergeant in the army.
entries.question: 你認識當過中士的人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know anyone who has been a sergeant?
entries.answer: 認識，我叔叔以前是陸軍中士。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my uncle used to be an army sergeant.

entries.example: 這位議員很關心捷運的問題。
entries.exampleEnglish: This councillor cares a lot about MRT issues.
entries.question: 你知道你們區的議員是誰嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know who your district's councillor is?
entries.answer: 不知道，我還不認識我們區的議員。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't know our district's councillor yet.

entries.example: 這間老房子是維多利亞式的建築。
entries.exampleEnglish: This old house is a Victorian-style building.
entries.question: 你喜歡維多利亞式的房子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like Victorian houses?
entries.answer: 喜歡，維多利亞式的房子看起來很優雅。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, Victorian houses look very elegant.

entries.example: 大哥從小就是我們家的保護者。
entries.exampleEnglish: My big brother has been our family's protector since we were kids.
entries.question: 小時候，誰是你的保護者？
entries.questionEnglish: When you were little, who was your protector?
entries.answer: 我哥哥一直是我的保護者。
entries.answerEnglish: My older brother was always my protector.

entries.example: 他是我工作上最好的助手。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's my best assistant at work.
entries.question: 你工作時需要一個助手嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you need an assistant at work?
entries.answer: 需要，我很想要一個好助手。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd really like a good assistant.

entries.example: 這家咖啡店隱藏在小巷子裡。
entries.exampleEnglish: This café is hidden in a little alley.
entries.question: 你知道哪些隱藏在巷子裡的好店？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know any good shops hidden in alleys?
entries.answer: 我知道一家隱藏在巷子裡的麵店。
entries.answerEnglish: I know a noodle shop hidden in an alley.

entries.example: 這種藥物要飯後吃。
entries.exampleEnglish: This medication should be taken after meals.
entries.question: 在台灣，哪裡可以買到藥物？
entries.questionEnglish: Where can you buy medication in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 藥局可以買到很多藥物。
entries.answerEnglish: You can buy many kinds of medication at a pharmacy.

entries.example: 這是一家老牌的麵包店。
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a long-established bakery.
entries.question: 你喜歡去老牌的餐廳吃飯嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like eating at long-established restaurants?
entries.answer: 喜歡，老牌的餐廳味道比較穩定。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, long-established restaurants are more consistent in flavor.

entries.example: 我十幾歲的時候住在倫敦。
entries.exampleEnglish: I lived in London when I was a teenager.
entries.question: 你十幾歲的時候喜歡做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What did you like to do when you were a teenager?
entries.answer: 我十幾歲的時候很喜歡打電動。
entries.answerEnglish: When I was a teenager, I loved playing video games.

entries.example: 這間辦公室的照明很好，不傷眼睛。
entries.exampleEnglish: The lighting in this office is good, so it's easy on the eyes.
entries.question: 你家客廳的照明夠亮嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is the lighting in your living room bright enough?
entries.answer: 不太夠，客廳的照明有點暗。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really, the lighting in the living room is a bit dim.

entries.example: 據報導，颱風明天會到台灣。
entries.exampleEnglish: Reportedly, the typhoon will reach Taiwan tomorrow.
entries.question: 最近有什麼新聞讓你很驚訝？
entries.questionEnglish: What news has surprised you lately?
entries.answer: 據報導，雞蛋又要漲價了。
entries.answerEnglish: Reportedly, eggs are going up in price again.

entries.example: 價錢是次要的，品質比較重要。
entries.exampleEnglish: Price is secondary; quality matters more.
entries.question: 買手機時，什麼對你來說是次要的？
entries.questionEnglish: When you buy a phone, what's secondary for you?
entries.answer: 顏色對我來說是次要的。
entries.answerEnglish: The color is secondary for me.

entries.example: 我們家住在台北的郊區。
entries.exampleEnglish: We live in the suburbs of Taipei.
entries.question: 你喜歡住在市中心還是郊區？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer living downtown or in the suburbs?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡住在郊區，比較安靜。
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer living in the suburbs; it's quieter.

entries.example: 很多國家都有種族歧視的問題。
entries.exampleEnglish: Many countries have problems with racism.
entries.question: 怎麼做可以減少種族歧視？
entries.questionEnglish: What can be done to reduce racism?
entries.answer: 多認識不同的文化可以減少種族歧視。
entries.answerEnglish: Learning more about different cultures can reduce racism.

entries.example: 他們對我很好，沒把我當外人。
entries.exampleEnglish: They're very kind to me and don't treat me like an outsider.
entries.question: 住在台灣，你會覺得自己是外人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Living in Taiwan, do you feel like an outsider?
entries.answer: 不會，我的朋友都沒把我當外人。
entries.answerEnglish: No, my friends don't treat me like an outsider.

entries.example: 股價下跌，他把手上的持股都賣了。
entries.exampleEnglish: When the stock price fell, he sold all his shares.
entries.question: 你會常常看自己的持股嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you check your stock holdings often?
entries.answer: 會，我每天下班都會看一下我的持股。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I check my holdings every day after work.

entries.example: 這位律師是這筆基金的受託人。
entries.exampleEnglish: This lawyer is the trustee of the fund.
entries.question: 你覺得受託人需要什麼特質？
entries.questionEnglish: What qualities do you think a trustee needs?
entries.answer: 受託人一定要誠實又可靠。
entries.answerEnglish: A trustee must be honest and reliable.

entries.example: 我的手機剛剛收到豪雨警示。
entries.exampleEnglish: My phone just got a heavy-rain warning.
entries.question: 你的手機常收到什麼警示？
entries.questionEnglish: What alerts does your phone often get?
entries.answer: 我常收到地震和豪雨的警示。
entries.answerEnglish: I often get earthquake and heavy-rain alerts.

entries.example: 我奶奶個性很豁達，什麼事都看得開。
entries.exampleEnglish: My grandma is very philosophical; she takes everything in stride.
entries.question: 你覺得自己是個豁達的人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're an easygoing person?
entries.answer: 我覺得我滿豁達的，很少為小事生氣。
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm pretty easygoing; I rarely get upset over small things.

entries.example: 老闆的指令不太清楚，大家都很困擾。
entries.exampleEnglish: The boss's instructions weren't clear, so everyone was confused.
entries.question: 你會用語音給手機下指令嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you give your phone voice commands?
entries.answer: 會，我常用語音指令設定鬧鐘。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often use voice commands to set alarms.

entries.example: 在那部連續劇裡，他是老闆的私生子。
entries.exampleEnglish: In that TV drama, he's the boss's illegitimate son.
entries.question: 很多連續劇都有私生子的故事嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do a lot of TV dramas have stories about illegitimate children?
entries.answer: 對，很多連續劇都有私生子的故事。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, lots of TV dramas have storylines about illegitimate children.

entries.example: 今天太陽很大，衣服很快就曬乾了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The sun is strong today, so the clothes dried quickly.
entries.question: 你洗完衣服會用烘衣機還是曬乾？
entries.questionEnglish: After washing clothes, do you use a dryer or dry them in the sun?
entries.answer: 天氣好的時候，我會拿到陽台曬乾。
entries.answerEnglish: When the weather is nice, I hang them on the balcony to dry.

entries.example: 他加盟了一家手搖飲料店。
entries.exampleEnglish: He opened a franchise of a bubble-tea chain.
entries.question: 如果開店，你想加盟還是自己開？
entries.questionEnglish: If you opened a shop, would you franchise or start your own?
entries.answer: 我想加盟有名的品牌，比較安全。
entries.answerEnglish: I'd franchise a well-known brand; it's safer.

entries.example: 我們今晚叫披薩來吃吧！
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's order pizza tonight!
entries.question: 你喜歡吃什麼口味的披薩？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of pizza do you like?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡吃海鮮披薩。
entries.answerEnglish: I like seafood pizza best.

entries.example: 受刑人在監獄裡也可以上課學技術。
entries.exampleEnglish: Inmates can also take classes and learn skills in prison.
entries.question: 受刑人在監獄裡可以做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What can inmates do in prison?
entries.answer: 受刑人可以上課，也可以學做麵包。
entries.answerEnglish: Inmates can take classes and also learn to bake bread.

entries.example: 這家工廠是一位大資本家開的。
entries.exampleEnglish: This factory was set up by a big capitalist.
entries.question: 你覺得資本家都很有錢嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think capitalists are all rich?
entries.answer: 大部分的資本家應該都很有錢。
entries.answerEnglish: I think most capitalists are pretty rich.

entries.example: 蛤？你說什麼？我沒聽到。
entries.exampleEnglish: Huh? What did you say? I didn't hear.
entries.question: 沒聽清楚別人說話時，你會說什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you say when you didn't catch what someone said?
entries.answer: 我會說：「蛤？可以再說一次嗎？」
entries.answerEnglish: I'd say, "Huh? Can you say that again?"

entries.example: 他們開車拉著拖車去露營。
entries.exampleEnglish: They drove to the campsite pulling a trailer.
entries.question: 你看過有人拉著拖車去露營嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen people pull a trailer to go camping?
entries.answer: 看過，在美國很多人拉著拖車去露營。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, in the US lots of people pull trailers to go camping.

entries.example: 航空博物館裡有一架老轟炸機。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's an old bomber in the aviation museum.
entries.question: 你在博物館看過轟炸機嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen a bomber in a museum?
entries.answer: 看過，我在美國的航空博物館看過轟炸機。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw a bomber at an aviation museum in the US.

entries.example: 我的家人都很支持我來台灣。
entries.exampleEnglish: My family really supports my coming to Taiwan.
entries.question: 你的家人支持你學中文嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your family support you learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 很支持，他們覺得學中文很有用。
entries.answerEnglish: Very much. They think learning Chinese is really useful.

entries.example: 這件黑色洋裝很性感。
entries.exampleEnglish: This black dress is very sexy.
entries.question: 廣告裡常常用性感的模特兒嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do ads often use sexy models?
entries.answer: 對，很多廣告都用性感的模特兒。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, many ads use sexy models.

entries.example: 坐輪椅的人也可以搭捷運。
entries.exampleEnglish: People in wheelchairs can take the MRT too.
entries.question: 坐輪椅的人在台灣出門方便嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is it easy for wheelchair users to get around in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 還算方便，坐輪椅也能搭公車和捷運。
entries.answerEnglish: Fairly easy. Wheelchair users can take buses and the MRT.

entries.example: 電影看到一半，我就睡著了。
entries.exampleEnglish: I fell asleep halfway through the movie.
entries.question: 你常常看電影看到一半就睡著嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often fall asleep halfway through a movie?
entries.answer: 常常，我在家看電影常看到一半就睡著。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. When I watch movies at home, I often fall asleep halfway.

entries.example: 台北市有十二個行政區。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taipei City has twelve administrative districts.
entries.question: 你最喜歡台北的哪個行政區？
entries.questionEnglish: Which district of Taipei do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡大安區這個行政區。
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite district is Da'an.

entries.example: 這個喇叭的低音很強。
entries.exampleEnglish: This speaker has really strong bass.
entries.question: 你喜歡低音很重的音樂嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like music with heavy bass?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我聽音樂喜歡低音重一點。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like my music with heavier bass.

entries.example: 這張照片有點不清楚。
entries.exampleEnglish: This photo is a little unclear.
entries.question: 工作上有不清楚的事，你會問誰？
entries.questionEnglish: When something at work is unclear, who do you ask?
entries.answer: 我有不清楚的事會問同事。
entries.answerEnglish: When something's unclear, I ask my coworkers.

entries.example: 他每個週末都去打曲棍球。
entries.exampleEnglish: He plays hockey every weekend.
entries.question: 你打過曲棍球嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever played hockey?
entries.answer: 沒打過，但我很喜歡看曲棍球比賽。
entries.answerEnglish: No, but I love watching hockey games.

entries.example: 我們公司這個月來了三個新人。
entries.exampleEnglish: Three new people joined our company this month.
entries.question: 你剛到公司當新人時緊張嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Were you nervous when you were new at your company?
entries.answer: 很緊張，當新人的時候什麼都不懂。
entries.answerEnglish: Very nervous. As a newcomer, I didn't know anything.

entries.example: 我老闆對細節很挑剔。
entries.exampleEnglish: My boss is very picky about details.
entries.question: 你買衣服時很挑剔嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you picky when you buy clothes?
entries.answer: 很挑剔，我一定會試穿很多件。
entries.answerEnglish: Very picky. I always try on lots of pieces.

entries.example: 我午餐吃了一盤義大利麵。
entries.exampleEnglish: I had a plate of pasta for lunch.
entries.question: 你會自己煮義大利麵嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you cook pasta yourself?
entries.answer: 會，我常常在家煮義大利麵。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often cook pasta at home.

entries.example: 這場比賽沒有輸家，大家都很棒。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are no losers in this game; everyone did great.
entries.question: 玩遊戲當輸家時，你會生氣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you get angry when you lose a game?
entries.answer: 不會，當輸家也沒關係，好玩就好。
entries.answerEnglish: No. It's fine to be the loser, as long as it's fun.

entries.example: 我家的狗是一隻母狗。
entries.exampleEnglish: Our dog is a female.
entries.question: 你喜歡養公狗還是母狗？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer male or female dogs as pets?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡養母狗，比較乖。
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer female dogs; they're better behaved.

entries.example: 醫生說他的手術很順利。
entries.exampleEnglish: The doctor said his surgery went smoothly.
entries.question: 做手術前通常要注意什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you usually need to watch out for before surgery?
entries.answer: 做手術前通常不能吃東西。
entries.answerEnglish: Before surgery, you usually can't eat anything.

entries.example: 她是一位很有名的音樂創作者。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's a very well-known music creator.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪一位網路創作者？
entries.questionEnglish: Which online creator do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡一位介紹台灣美食的創作者。
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite is a creator who introduces Taiwanese food.

entries.example: 德國北部很多人信新教。
entries.exampleEnglish: Many people in northern Germany are Protestant.
entries.question: 你的國家信新教的人多嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there many Protestants in your country?
entries.answer: 很多，我的國家大部分的人信新教。
entries.answerEnglish: Quite a lot. Most people in my country are Protestant.

entries.example: 這一洞的標準桿是四桿。
entries.exampleEnglish: Par for this hole is four.
entries.question: 你打高爾夫球能打到標準桿嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you shoot par when you play golf?
entries.answer: 不行，我的成績離標準桿還差很多。
entries.answerEnglish: No, my scores are still way over par.

entries.example: 我去運動用品店買了一雙球鞋。
entries.exampleEnglish: I went to a sporting goods store and bought a pair of sneakers.
entries.question: 你常去哪裡買運動用品？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you usually buy sports gear?
entries.answer: 我常在網路上買運動用品。
entries.answerEnglish: I often buy sports gear online.

entries.example: 會員有免費停車的特權。
entries.exampleEnglish: Members have the privilege of free parking.
entries.question: 你覺得有錢人有很多特權嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think rich people have a lot of privileges?
entries.answer: 有，有錢人常常有很多特權。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, rich people often have lots of privileges.

entries.example: 手機成癮是很多人的問題。
entries.exampleEnglish: Phone addiction is a problem for many people.
entries.question: 什麼東西容易讓人成癮？
entries.questionEnglish: What things can easily make people addicted?
entries.answer: 手機遊戲很容易讓人成癮。
entries.answerEnglish: Mobile games can easily make people addicted.

entries.example: 一位警員在路口指揮交通。
entries.exampleEnglish: A police officer is directing traffic at the intersection.
entries.question: 迷路的時候，你會找警員幫忙嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you're lost, do you ask a police officer for help?
entries.answer: 會，我會找附近的警員問路。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd ask a nearby police officer for directions.

entries.example: 澳門有很多很大的賭場。
entries.exampleEnglish: Macau has lots of huge casinos.
entries.question: 哪些地方有很多賭場？
entries.questionEnglish: Which places have a lot of casinos?
entries.answer: 澳門和拉斯維加斯有很多賭場。
entries.answerEnglish: Macau and Las Vegas have lots of casinos.

entries.example: 這家餐廳在網路上的排名很高。
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant ranks very high online.
entries.question: 選餐廳時，你會看網路排名嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you choose a restaurant, do you look at online rankings?
entries.answer: 會，我常參考網路上的排名。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often check online rankings.

entries.example: 在一些國家，性工作者可以合法工作。
entries.exampleEnglish: In some countries, sex workers can work legally.
entries.question: 性工作者需要幫助時可以找誰？
entries.questionEnglish: Who can sex workers turn to when they need help?
entries.answer: 性工作者可以找社福團體幫忙。
entries.answerEnglish: Sex workers can turn to social welfare groups for help.

entries.example: 這家公司一直追求卓越的品質。
entries.exampleEnglish: This company always strives for excellent quality.
entries.question: 你覺得卓越的主管需要什麼特質？
entries.questionEnglish: What qualities do you think an outstanding manager needs?
entries.answer: 卓越的主管要懂得聽員工的意見。
entries.answerEnglish: An outstanding manager needs to know how to listen to employees.

entries.example: 他用假的網站欺騙了很多人。
entries.exampleEnglish: He deceived a lot of people with a fake website.
entries.question: 你會原諒欺騙你的人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you forgive someone who deceived you?
entries.answer: 很難，我不太能原諒欺騙我的人。
entries.answerEnglish: That's hard. I can't really forgive people who deceive me.

entries.example: 這個商標很好認，大家都知道。
entries.exampleEnglish: This logo is easy to recognize; everyone knows it.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪家公司的商標？
entries.questionEnglish: Which company's logo do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡那家咖啡店的綠色商標。
entries.answerEnglish: I like that coffee chain's green logo best.

entries.example: 她是報紙的美食專欄作家。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's a food columnist for a newspaper.
entries.question: 你有喜歡的專欄作家嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a columnist you like?
entries.answer: 有，我很喜歡一位寫旅遊的專欄作家。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I really like a columnist who writes about travel.

entries.example: 便利商店也買得到保險套。
entries.exampleEnglish: You can buy condoms at convenience stores too.
entries.question: 在台灣，哪裡可以買到保險套？
entries.questionEnglish: Where can you buy condoms in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 藥局和便利商店都買得到保險套。
entries.answerEnglish: You can buy condoms at pharmacies and convenience stores.

entries.example: 很多環保人士反對蓋新的機場。
entries.exampleEnglish: Many environmentalists oppose building the new airport.
entries.question: 你覺得自己算是環保人士嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you call yourself an environmentalist?
entries.answer: 不算環保人士，但我會做資源回收。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm not really an environmentalist, but I do recycle.

entries.example: 他因為酒駕被警察拘留了。
entries.exampleEnglish: He was detained by the police for drunk driving.
entries.question: 被拘留的人可以找誰幫忙？
entries.questionEnglish: Who can people who are detained turn to for help?
entries.answer: 被拘留的人可以找律師幫忙。
entries.answerEnglish: People who are detained can ask a lawyer for help.

entries.example: 我們在法國參觀了一座老修道院。
entries.exampleEnglish: We visited an old abbey in France.
entries.question: 你參觀過修道院嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever visited an abbey?
entries.answer: 參觀過，我在英國看過一座很美的修道院。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw a beautiful abbey in England.

entries.example: 長時間看手機對眼睛不好。
entries.exampleEnglish: Looking at your phone for long periods is bad for your eyes.
entries.question: 你上班需要長時間坐著嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have to sit for long periods at work?
entries.answer: 對，我上班要長時間坐在電腦前。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have to sit at a computer for long hours at work.

entries.example: 這次開會大家提出了很多建設性的意見。
entries.exampleEnglish: Everyone made a lot of constructive suggestions at this meeting.
entries.question: 開會時，你常提出有建設性的想法嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often put forward constructive ideas in meetings?
entries.answer: 我會盡量提出有建設性的建議。
entries.answerEnglish: I try to make constructive suggestions.

entries.example: 消防隊五分鐘就到了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The fire brigade arrived in just five minutes.
entries.question: 你們公司有球隊嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company have a sports team?
entries.answer: 有，我們公司有一支羽球隊。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our company has a badminton team.

entries.example: 門卡住了，打不開。
entries.exampleEnglish: The door is stuck and won't open.
entries.question: 你的電腦常常卡住嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your computer often freeze?
entries.answer: 常常，我的舊電腦一直卡住。
entries.answerEnglish: All the time. My old computer keeps freezing.

entries.example: 她在大學當英文講師。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's an English lecturer at a university.
entries.question: 你覺得好的講師需要什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think a good lecturer needs?
entries.answer: 好的講師說話要清楚又有趣。
entries.answerEnglish: A good lecturer needs to speak clearly and be interesting.

entries.example: 那個業務很狡猾，你要小心。
entries.exampleEnglish: That salesperson is sly; be careful.
entries.question: 你遇過狡猾的商人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever met a sly businessperson?
entries.answer: 遇過，有個狡猾的老闆多收了我的錢。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a sly shop owner once overcharged me.

entries.example: 我們教會的牧師很親切。
entries.exampleEnglish: The pastor at our church is very friendly.
entries.question: 你認識當牧師的人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know anyone who is a pastor?
entries.answer: 認識，我的叔叔是一位牧師。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my uncle is a pastor.

entries.example: 這個防空洞是戰時蓋的。
entries.exampleEnglish: This air-raid shelter was built during the war.
entries.question: 戰時的人們過著怎樣的生活？
entries.questionEnglish: What was life like for people in wartime?
entries.answer: 戰時的人們常常沒有足夠的食物。
entries.answerEnglish: People in wartime often didn't have enough food.

entries.example: 你會累是可以理解的。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's understandable that you're tired.
entries.question: 朋友遲到，你覺得可以理解嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: If a friend is late, do you think it's understandable?
entries.answer: 如果是塞車，我覺得可以理解。
entries.answerEnglish: If it's because of traffic, I think it's understandable.

entries.example: 遲到太多次會被公司懲戒。
entries.exampleEnglish: If you're late too many times, the company will discipline you.
entries.question: 公司通常怎麼懲戒常遲到的員工？
entries.questionEnglish: How do companies usually discipline employees who are often late?
entries.answer: 公司常用扣薪水的方式來懲戒。
entries.answerEnglish: Companies often discipline them by docking their pay.

entries.example: 罷工者在公司門口拿著牌子。
entries.exampleEnglish: The strikers are holding signs at the company gate.
entries.question: 罷工者通常想要什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do strikers usually want?
entries.answer: 罷工者通常想要更好的薪水。
entries.answerEnglish: Strikers usually want better pay.

entries.example: 我爺爺還在用老式的收音機。
entries.exampleEnglish: My grandpa still uses an old-fashioned radio.
entries.question: 你家裡有老式的東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any old-fashioned things at home?
entries.answer: 有，我有一台老式的底片相機。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have an old-style film camera.

entries.example: 我明天要在會議上做簡報。
entries.exampleEnglish: I have to give a presentation at the meeting tomorrow.
entries.question: 你工作時常常要做簡報嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often have to give presentations at work?
entries.answer: 常常，我每週都要做一次簡報。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I have to give a presentation every week.

entries.example: 她們是一對女同志伴侶。
entries.exampleEnglish: They're a lesbian couple.
entries.question: 在台灣，女同志可以結婚嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can lesbians get married in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 可以，台灣的女同志可以合法結婚。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, lesbians in Taiwan can legally marry.

entries.example: 早上的公園有很多退休人士在運動。
entries.exampleEnglish: In the morning, the park is full of retirees exercising.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣適合退休人士住嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwan is a good place for retirees to live?
entries.answer: 很適合，台灣的生活對退休人士很方便。
entries.answerEnglish: Very much. Life in Taiwan is very convenient for retirees.

entries.example: 這批貨要用船運送到日本。
entries.exampleEnglish: This shipment will be sent to Japan by sea.
entries.question: 你在網路上買東西，運送要多久？
entries.questionEnglish: When you buy things online, how long does delivery take?
entries.answer: 通常運送兩三天就到了。
entries.answerEnglish: Delivery usually takes just two or three days.

entries.example: 秋天的台北天氣很怡人。
entries.exampleEnglish: The weather in Taipei in autumn is delightful.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣哪個季節最怡人？
entries.questionEnglish: Which season in Taiwan do you think is the most pleasant?
entries.answer: 我覺得秋天最怡人，不冷也不熱。
entries.answerEnglish: I think autumn is the most pleasant; it's neither cold nor hot.

entries.example: 我常去家附近的髮廊剪頭髮。
entries.exampleEnglish: I usually get my hair cut at a salon near my home.
entries.question: 你多久去一次髮廊？
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you go to the hair salon?
entries.answer: 我大概兩個月去一次髮廊。
entries.answerEnglish: I go to the salon about every two months.

entries.example: 這家麵店的味道十年不變。
entries.exampleEnglish: This noodle shop's flavor has stayed the same for ten years.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣什麼東西一直不變？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think has never changed in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我覺得夜市的熱鬧一直不變。
entries.answerEnglish: I think the buzz of the night markets never changes.

entries.example: 我是受薪族，每個月領固定的薪水。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm a salaried worker; I get a fixed salary every month.
entries.question: 你是受薪族還是自己當老闆？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you a salaried employee or your own boss?
entries.answer: 我是受薪族，在一家外商上班。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm a salaried employee at a foreign company.

entries.example: 健康檢查要驗血液和尿液。
entries.exampleEnglish: A health check involves testing your blood and urine.
entries.question: 健康檢查通常會檢查什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What does a health check usually test?
entries.answer: 通常會檢查血液和尿液。
entries.answerEnglish: They usually check your blood and urine.

entries.example: 公司的發言人今天開了記者會。
entries.exampleEnglish: The company's spokeswoman held a press conference today.
entries.question: 你覺得當發言人難不難？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think being a spokesperson is hard?
entries.answer: 很難，發言人說話要非常小心。
entries.answerEnglish: Very hard. A spokesperson has to be very careful about what they say.

entries.example: 這件事請你幫我保密。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please keep this a secret for me.
entries.question: 朋友告訴你祕密，你會保密嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: If a friend tells you a secret, do you keep it?
entries.answer: 會，我一定會幫朋友保密。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always keep my friends' secrets.

entries.example: 週末的海邊有很多釣客。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of anglers at the seaside on weekends.
entries.question: 你家附近有很多釣客嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there many anglers near where you live?
entries.answer: 有，週末河邊有很多釣客。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are lots of anglers by the river on weekends.

entries.example: 山上的林地不能隨便蓋房子。
entries.exampleEnglish: You can't just build houses on the forest land in the mountains.
entries.question: 你家附近有林地嗎？

entries.answer: 有，我家後面有一大片林地。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a big stretch of woodland behind my house.

entries.example: 老闆罵他，他也不敢回嘴。
entries.exampleEnglish: When the boss scolded him, he didn't dare talk back.
entries.question: 被別人罵的時候，你會回嘴嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When someone scolds you, do you talk back?
entries.answer: 通常不會，我很少跟人回嘴。
entries.answerEnglish: Usually not. I rarely talk back to people.

entries.example: 教練下半場換了新的戰術。
entries.exampleEnglish: The coach switched to new tactics in the second half.
entries.question: 看球賽時，你會注意球隊的戰術嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you watch a game, do you pay attention to the team's tactics?
entries.answer: 會，我很喜歡研究籃球的戰術。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love analyzing basketball tactics.

entries.example: 那座老莊園現在變成了飯店。
entries.exampleEnglish: That old manor has now become a hotel.
entries.question: 你想住在莊園裡嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to live on an estate?
entries.answer: 想，住在莊園裡一定很舒服。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, living on an estate must be really comfortable.

entries.exampleEnglish: This used to be a battlefield; now it's a park.
entries.question: 你參觀過以前的戰場嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever visited a former battlefield?
entries.answer: 參觀過，我去過諾曼第的戰場。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've been to the battlefields in Normandy.

entries.example: 他開會時講了很多廢話。
entries.exampleEnglish: He talked a lot of nonsense in the meeting.
entries.question: 你討厭別人講廢話嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you hate it when people talk nonsense?
entries.answer: 很討厭，開會講廢話很浪費時間。
entries.answerEnglish: I hate it. Talking nonsense in meetings wastes time.

entries.example: 她是一位很受尊敬的醫生。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's a highly respected doctor.
entries.question: 在你的國家，哪種工作很受尊敬？
entries.questionEnglish: In your country, what kinds of jobs are highly respected?
entries.answer: 在我的國家，醫生和老師很受尊敬。
entries.answerEnglish: In my country, doctors and teachers are highly respected.

entries.example: 這些咖啡豆是屏東的種植者種的。
entries.exampleEnglish: These coffee beans were grown by growers in Pingtung.
entries.question: 你想過當咖啡種植者嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever thought about being a coffee grower?
entries.answer: 想過，當咖啡種植者應該很有趣。
entries.answerEnglish: I have. Being a coffee grower would be really interesting.

entries.example: 警察很快就抓到了攻擊者。
entries.exampleEnglish: The police quickly caught the attacker.
entries.question: 看到攻擊者時應該怎麼做？

entries.example: 這座公園下個月會重新開放。
entries.exampleEnglish: This park will reopen next month.
entries.question: 你最希望哪個地方重新開放？
entries.questionEnglish: Which place do you most hope will reopen?
entries.answer: 我希望家附近的老戲院可以重新開放。
entries.answerEnglish: I hope the old theater near my home can reopen.

entries.exampleEnglish: My cat is sick, so I need to take it to the vet.
entries.question: 你多久帶寵物看一次獸醫？
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you take your pet to the vet?
entries.answer: 我每年帶我的狗看一次獸醫。
entries.answerEnglish: I take my dog to the vet once a year.

entries.example: 會議還在進行中，請等一下。
entries.exampleEnglish: The meeting is still in progress; please wait a moment.
entries.question: 你現在有什麼計畫在進行中？
entries.questionEnglish: What plans do you have underway right now?
entries.answer: 我的學中文計畫正在進行中。
entries.answerEnglish: My plan to learn Chinese is underway.

entries.example: 這位立法委員很關心交通問題。
entries.exampleEnglish: This legislator cares a lot about traffic issues.
entries.question: 你知道台灣有幾位立法委員嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know how many legislators Taiwan has?
entries.answer: 台灣有一百一十三位立法委員。
entries.answerEnglish: Taiwan has 113 legislators.

entries.example: 在航空展上，我們進去看了飛機的駕駛艙。
entries.exampleEnglish: At the air show, we went in and looked at the plane's cockpit.
entries.question: 你進去過飛機的駕駛艙嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been inside a plane's cockpit?
entries.answer: 沒有，我很想看看駕駛艙長什麼樣子。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I'd love to see what a cockpit looks like.

entries.example: 這首歌讓人想起大學的時候。
entries.exampleEnglish: This song brings back memories of college.
entries.question: 什麼食物最讓人想起家鄉？
entries.questionEnglish: What food reminds you most of home?
entries.answer: 我覺得媽媽煮的湯最讓人想起家鄉。
entries.answerEnglish: I think Mom's soup reminds you of home the most.

entries.example: 這家飯店的服務是一流的。
entries.exampleEnglish: This hotel's service is first-rate.
entries.question: 你覺得哪家餐廳的服務是一流的？
entries.questionEnglish: Which restaurant do you think has first-rate service?
entries.answer: 我覺得那家日本料理店的服務是一流的。
entries.answerEnglish: I think that Japanese restaurant's service is first-rate.

entries.example: 我住在一間小小的套房。
entries.exampleEnglish: I live in a tiny studio apartment.
entries.question: 你的房間大不大？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your room big?
entries.answer: 不大，我的房間小小的，但很舒服。
entries.answerEnglish: Not big. My room is tiny, but it's comfortable.

entries.example: 這場棒球比賽打到第九局。
entries.exampleEnglish: This baseball game went into the ninth inning.
entries.question: 一場棒球比賽通常有幾局？
entries.questionEnglish: How many innings does a baseball game usually have?
entries.answer: 一場棒球比賽通常有九局。
entries.answerEnglish: A baseball game usually has nine innings.

entries.example: 他在一所理工學院念電機。
entries.exampleEnglish: He studied electrical engineering at a polytechnic.
entries.question: 你的國家有有名的理工學院嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your country have a famous institute of technology?
entries.answer: 有，我的國家有一所很有名的理工學院。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my country has a very famous institute of technology.

entries.example: 這間廁所是給身障人士用的。
entries.exampleEnglish: This restroom is for people with disabilities.
entries.question: 哪裡可以看到身障專用的設施？
entries.questionEnglish: Where can you find facilities for people with disabilities?
entries.answer: 捷運站和車站都有身障專用的設施。
entries.answerEnglish: MRT and train stations both have facilities for disabled people.

entries.example: 警察已經抓到了持槍歹徒。
entries.exampleEnglish: The police have caught the gunman.
entries.question: 看到持槍歹徒時應該怎麼做？
entries.questionEnglish: What should you do if you see a gunman?
entries.answer: 看到持槍歹徒要馬上躲好，再報警。
entries.answerEnglish: If you see a gunman, hide immediately and then call the police.

entries.example: 下大雨時，駕駛人要開慢一點。
entries.exampleEnglish: When it rains hard, drivers should go slower.

entries.answer: 有些駕駛人開車很快，不太小心。
entries.answerEnglish: Some drivers drive fast and aren't very careful.

entries.example: 水沸騰以後再放麵。
entries.exampleEnglish: Put the noodles in after the water boils.
entries.question: 你煮麵時會等水沸騰嗎？

entries.answer: 會，我都等水沸騰了才放麵。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always wait until the water boils before adding the noodles.

entries.example: 精子是男性的生殖細胞。
entries.exampleEnglish: Sperm are male reproductive cells.
entries.question: 精子和卵子結合會變成什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do a sperm and an egg become when they combine?
entries.answer: 精子和卵子結合會變成受精卵。
entries.answerEnglish: When a sperm and an egg combine, they become a fertilized egg.

entries.example: 曬傷的時候可以擦蘆薈凝膠。
entries.exampleEnglish: You can put aloe gel on sunburn.
entries.question: 夏天你會用蘆薈凝膠嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use aloe gel in summer?
entries.answer: 會，曬完太陽我會擦一點蘆薈凝膠。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, after being in the sun I put on a little aloe gel.

entries.example: 颱風過後，路上散落著很多樹枝。
entries.exampleEnglish: After the typhoon, branches were scattered all over the road.
entries.question: 你的房間裡常有散落的衣服嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there often clothes scattered around your room?
entries.answer: 常常，我的衣服常常散落在床上。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. My clothes are often scattered on the bed.

entries.exampleEnglish: I got a foot massage on the weekend.
entries.question: 你喜歡去按摩嗎？

entries.answer: 很喜歡，按摩完覺得很放鬆。
entries.answerEnglish: I love it. I feel so relaxed after a massage.

entries.question: 冬天你會在家燉湯嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you make stewed soups at home in winter?
entries.answer: 會，我冬天常常燉雞湯。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often simmer chicken soup in winter.

entries.example: 她在一家跨國公司上班。
entries.exampleEnglish: She works at a multinational company.
entries.question: 你想在跨國公司工作嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to work at a multinational company?
entries.answer: 想，在跨國公司可以認識很多國家的人。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, at a multinational you get to meet people from many countries.

entries.example: 午餐時間，便利商店人很多。
entries.exampleEnglish: At lunchtime, convenience stores are crowded.
entries.question: 你的午餐時間有多久？
entries.questionEnglish: How long is your lunch break?
entries.answer: 我的午餐時間有一個小時。
entries.answerEnglish: My lunch break is an hour.

entries.example: 那個傢伙每次開會都遲到。
entries.exampleEnglish: That guy is late for every meeting.
entries.question: 你的同事裡有很好笑的傢伙嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there any really funny guys among your coworkers?
entries.answer: 有，有個傢伙每天都講笑話。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's one guy who tells jokes every day.

entries.example: 我們坐在公園的樹樁上休息。
entries.exampleEnglish: We sat on a tree stump in the park to rest.
entries.question: 你在山上看過很大的樹樁嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen a huge tree stump in the mountains?
entries.answer: 看過，阿里山上有很大的樹樁。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are huge tree stumps on Alishan.

entries.example: 義大利麵上撒了一點巴西里。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a little parsley sprinkled on the pasta.
entries.question: 你做菜時會放巴西里嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use parsley when you cook?
entries.answer: 會，我煮義大利麵會放一點巴西里。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I put a little parsley in when I make pasta.

entries.example: 他的球打進了沙坑。
entries.exampleEnglish: He hit his ball into the bunker.
entries.question: 你小時候喜歡在沙坑玩嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you like playing in the sandpit when you were little?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常在公園的沙坑玩沙。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often played in the sandpit at the park.

entries.example: 新聞播出了地震時的畫面。
entries.exampleEnglish: The news showed footage from the earthquake.
entries.question: 你常用手機拍下好看的畫面嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often film beautiful scenes on your phone?
entries.answer: 會，我常拍下夕陽的畫面。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often film sunsets on my phone.

entries.example: 他們請了一位保母照顧小孩。
entries.exampleEnglish: They hired a nanny to look after their kids.
entries.question: 你小時候有保母照顧你嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you have a nanny when you were little?
entries.answer: 有，我小時候有一位很好的保母。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I had a really nice nanny when I was little.

entries.english: throw away; chuck; get rid of
entries.example: 這些舊衣服可以丟掉了。
entries.exampleEnglish: These old clothes can be thrown out.
entries.question: 你常常把舊東西丟掉嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often throw out old things?
entries.answer: 會，我常把舊衣服丟掉。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often throw out old clothes.

entries.example: 這個新政策很不得人心。
entries.exampleEnglish: This new policy is very unpopular.
entries.question: 你覺得一直漲價會不得人心嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think constant price hikes will be unpopular?
entries.answer: 會，一直漲價一定不得人心。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, constant price hikes are bound to be unpopular.

entries.example: 他以前是一名拳擊手。
entries.exampleEnglish: He used to be a boxer.
entries.question: 你喜歡看拳擊手比賽嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like watching boxers fight?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我覺得拳擊手都很厲害。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I think boxers are really impressive.

entries.example: 空氣不好會影響呼吸道。
entries.exampleEnglish: Bad air can affect your airways.
entries.question: 怎麼保護呼吸道的健康？
entries.questionEnglish: How can you keep your airways healthy?
entries.answer: 出門戴口罩可以保護呼吸道。
entries.answerEnglish: Wearing a mask when you go out can protect your airways.

entries.example: 公司明年要重組幾個部門。
entries.exampleEnglish: The company will restructure several departments next year.
entries.question: 你覺得公司重組是好事嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think company restructuring is a good thing?
entries.answer: 不一定，公司重組常常讓員工很緊張。
entries.answerEnglish: Not necessarily. Restructuring often makes employees nervous.

entries.example: 巷口有幾個小混混在抽菸。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are a few punks smoking at the end of the alley.
entries.question: 晚上遇到小混混該怎麼辦？
entries.questionEnglish: What should you do if you run into punks at night?
entries.answer: 遇到小混混最好走開，不要理他們。
entries.answerEnglish: If you run into punks, it's best to walk away and ignore them.

entries.example: 這個國家終於結束了獨裁政權。
entries.exampleEnglish: This country finally ended its dictatorship.
entries.question: 獨裁政權下的人民有言論自由嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do people under a dictatorship have freedom of speech?
entries.answer: 通常沒有，獨裁政權會限制言論自由。
entries.answerEnglish: Usually not. Dictatorships restrict freedom of speech.

entries.example: 南非以前有種族隔離政策。
entries.exampleEnglish: South Africa used to have a policy of apartheid.
entries.question: 哪個國家以前有種族隔離？
entries.questionEnglish: Which country used to have apartheid?
entries.answer: 南非以前有種族隔離。
entries.answerEnglish: South Africa used to have apartheid.

entries.example: 她花了很多錢去找靈媒。
entries.exampleEnglish: She spent a lot of money going to a psychic.
entries.question: 你相信靈媒說的話嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you believe what psychics say?
entries.answer: 不太相信，我覺得靈媒說的不一定對。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. I don't think what psychics say is always right.

entries.example: 這條魚的魚鰭是藍色的。
entries.exampleEnglish: This fish's fins are blue.
entries.question: 你看過魚鰭很漂亮的魚嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen a fish with beautiful fins?
entries.answer: 看過，我家金魚的魚鰭很漂亮。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my goldfish has beautiful fins.

entries.example: 這個網站有色情內容，要滿十八歲才能看。
entries.exampleEnglish: This website has pornographic content; you must be 18 to view it.
entries.question: 為什麼有些電影要滿十八歲才能看？
entries.questionEnglish: Why can some movies only be watched by people 18 and over?
entries.answer: 因為裡面有暴力或色情的內容。
entries.answerEnglish: Because they contain violent or pornographic content.

entries.example: 陰莖是男性的生殖器官。
entries.exampleEnglish: The penis is a male reproductive organ.
entries.question: 陰莖有問題時應該看哪一科？
entries.questionEnglish: Which department should you go to for problems with the penis?
entries.answer: 陰莖有問題可以去看泌尿科。
entries.answerEnglish: For problems with the penis, you can see a urologist.

entries.example: 這個月的房貸還款日是十號。
entries.exampleEnglish: This month's mortgage payment is due on the 10th.
entries.question: 你每個月有固定要還款嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a fixed repayment to make every month?
entries.answer: 有，我每個月要還款給銀行。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I make a repayment to the bank every month.

entries.example: 大部分的印度人信印度教。
entries.exampleEnglish: Most Indians are Hindu.
entries.question: 你去過印度教的寺廟嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been to a Hindu temple?
entries.answer: 去過，我在新加坡參觀過印度教的寺廟。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I visited a Hindu temple in Singapore.

entries.example: 他是一位很紅的喜劇演員。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a very popular comedian.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪位喜劇演員？
entries.questionEnglish: Who's your favorite comedian?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡一位英國的喜劇演員。
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite is a British comedian.

entries.example: 那隻狗在電線桿旁邊撒尿。
entries.exampleEnglish: That dog is peeing next to the utility pole.
entries.question: 遛狗時，狗在路邊撒尿怎麼辦？
entries.questionEnglish: When you walk a dog, what do you do if it pees by the road?
entries.answer: 狗在路邊撒尿後，我會用水沖一沖。
entries.answerEnglish: After my dog pees by the road, I rinse it with water.

entries.example: 他的爺爺以前是海軍上將。
entries.exampleEnglish: His grandfather used to be an admiral.
entries.question: 你知道哪位有名的海軍上將？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know of any famous admirals?
entries.answer: 我知道英國的納爾遜海軍上將。
entries.answerEnglish: I know of Admiral Nelson from Britain.

entries.example: 這位播音員的聲音很好聽。
entries.exampleEnglish: This announcer has a lovely voice.
entries.question: 你喜歡聽哪位播音員的節目？
entries.questionEnglish: Which broadcaster's program do you like to listen to?
entries.answer: 我喜歡聽一位電台播音員的晚間節目。
entries.answerEnglish: I like listening to a radio announcer's evening show.

entries.example: 這只是非官方的消息，還不確定。
entries.exampleEnglish: This is only unofficial news; it's not confirmed yet.
entries.question: 你相信網路上非官方的消息嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you believe unofficial information online?
entries.answer: 不太相信，非官方的消息常常不對。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. Unofficial information is often wrong.

entries.example: 這台輕量筆電帶出門很方便。
entries.exampleEnglish: This lightweight laptop is easy to take out with you.
entries.question: 你出國時喜歡帶輕量的行李箱嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like taking a lightweight suitcase when you travel abroad?
entries.answer: 喜歡，輕量的行李箱比較好拿。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a lightweight suitcase is easier to carry.

entries.example: 在台灣，異性戀和同性戀都可以結婚。
entries.exampleEnglish: In Taiwan, both straight and gay couples can marry.
entries.question: 異性戀和同性戀有什麼不同？
entries.questionEnglish: What's the difference between heterosexual and homosexual?
entries.answer: 異性戀喜歡的是不同性別的人。
entries.answerEnglish: Heterosexual people are attracted to people of a different sex.

entries.example: 這部電影有一些情色的畫面。
entries.exampleEnglish: This film has some erotic scenes.
entries.question: 情色電影在台灣是什麼級？
entries.questionEnglish: What rating do erotic films get in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 情色電影在台灣通常是限制級。
entries.answerEnglish: In Taiwan, erotic films are usually rated R-18.

entries.example: 她今天穿得很時髦。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's dressed very stylishly today.
entries.question: 你覺得台北人穿得時髦嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think people in Taipei dress stylishly?
entries.answer: 很時髦，很多台北人都很會穿衣服。
entries.answerEnglish: Very stylish. Lots of people in Taipei really know how to dress.

entries.example: 今晚的節目有很多重量級的來賓。
entries.exampleEnglish: Tonight's show has lots of big-name guests.
entries.question: 你們公司有重量級的客戶嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company have any major clients?
entries.answer: 有，我們有幾個重量級的客戶。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we have a few major clients.

entries.example: 台灣的國民生產毛額每年都在成長。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan's GNP grows every year.
entries.question: 你知道哪個國家的國民生產毛額最高？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know which country has the highest GNP?
entries.answer: 美國的國民生產毛額最高。
entries.answerEnglish: The US has the highest GNP.

entries.example: 兩家公司的關係越來越惡化。
entries.exampleEnglish: Relations between the two companies are getting worse and worse.
entries.question: 什麼會讓交通問題惡化？
entries.questionEnglish: What makes traffic problems worse?
entries.answer: 下大雨常常會讓交通問題惡化。
entries.answerEnglish: Heavy rain often makes traffic problems worse.

entries.example: 我們把臥室換了新的壁紙。
entries.exampleEnglish: We put new wallpaper in the bedroom.
entries.question: 你喜歡家裡貼壁紙嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like having wallpaper at home?
entries.answer: 喜歡，貼壁紙可以讓房間更溫暖。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, wallpaper makes a room feel warmer.

entries.example: 她在藥妝店買了很多化妝品。
entries.exampleEnglish: She bought a lot of cosmetics at the drugstore.
entries.question: 你常在哪裡買化妝品？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you usually buy cosmetics?
entries.answer: 我常在藥妝店買化妝品。
entries.answerEnglish: I usually buy cosmetics at the drugstore.

entries.example: 該死，我又忘了帶雨傘！
entries.exampleEnglish: Damn, I forgot my umbrella again!
entries.question: 你什麼時候會說「該死」？
entries.questionEnglish: When do you say "damn"?
entries.answer: 錯過捷運的時候，我會說「該死」。
entries.answerEnglish: When I miss the MRT, I say "damn."

entries.example: 週末晚上夜店人很多。
entries.exampleEnglish: Nightclubs are packed on weekend nights.
entries.question: 你去過台北的夜店嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to a nightclub in Taipei?
entries.answer: 去過，我跟朋友去過信義區的夜店。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I went to a club in Xinyi District with friends.

entries.example: 這塊肉的脂肪太多了。
entries.exampleEnglish: This piece of meat has too much fat.
entries.question: 你吃肉時會把脂肪切掉嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you cut the fat off when you eat meat?
entries.answer: 會，我不喜歡吃肉的脂肪。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I don't like eating the fat on meat.

entries.example: 我們在花蓮住了一間青年旅館。
entries.exampleEnglish: We stayed at a hostel in Hualien.
entries.question: 你旅行時住過青年旅館嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you stayed in a hostel while traveling?
entries.answer: 住過，青年旅館便宜又可以交朋友。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, hostels are cheap and you can make friends.

entries.example: 不舒服的時候，我會先去看家庭醫師。
entries.exampleEnglish: When I don't feel well, I go to my family doctor first.
entries.question: 感冒時可以先去看哪種醫生？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of doctor can you see first when you have a cold?
entries.answer: 可以先去看家庭醫師。
entries.answerEnglish: You can see a family doctor first.

entries.example: 小報常常寫明星的八卦。
entries.exampleEnglish: Tabloids often write gossip about celebrities.
entries.question: 你相信小報寫的新聞嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you believe the stories in tabloids?
entries.answer: 不相信，小報的新聞常常是假的。
entries.answerEnglish: No, tabloid stories are often fake.

entries.example: 我的室友是英國人。
entries.exampleEnglish: My roommate is British.
entries.question: 你認識英國人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know any British people?
entries.answer: 認識，我的老闆是英國人。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my boss is British.

entries.example: 我等了你十分鐘。
entries.exampleEnglish: I waited for you for ten minutes.
entries.question: 你走路到捷運站要幾分鐘？
entries.questionEnglish: How many minutes does it take you to walk to the MRT station?
entries.answer: 大概五分鐘。
entries.answerEnglish: About five minutes.

entries.example: 我們去台中參觀了一座葡萄園。
entries.exampleEnglish: We visited a vineyard in Taichung.
entries.question: 你去過葡萄園嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been to a vineyard?
entries.answer: 去過，我在法國參觀過葡萄園。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I visited a vineyard in France.

entries.example: 他最後一桿推桿進洞，贏了比賽。
entries.exampleEnglish: He holed his final putt and won the tournament.
entries.question: 你打高爾夫球時推桿準嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you accurate when you putt in golf?
entries.answer: 不太準，我推桿常常太用力。
entries.answerEnglish: Not very. I often putt too hard.

entries.example: 比賽需要一位記分員來記分數。
entries.exampleEnglish: The game needs a scorekeeper to keep score.
entries.question: 你當過比賽的記分員嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been the scorekeeper at a game?
entries.answer: 當過，我在公司的球賽當過記分員。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I was the scorekeeper at a company ball game.

entries.example: 每個國家的司法系統都不太一樣。
entries.exampleEnglish: Every country's judicial system is a bit different.
entries.question: 司法系統裡有哪些工作？
entries.questionEnglish: What jobs are there in the judicial system?
entries.answer: 司法系統裡有法官、檢察官和律師。
entries.answerEnglish: The judicial system includes judges, prosecutors, and lawyers.

entries.example: 吉普賽人也叫做羅姆人。
entries.exampleEnglish: Gypsies are also called the Roma.
entries.question: 吉普賽人主要住在哪裡？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do the Roma mainly live?
entries.answer: 很多吉普賽人住在歐洲。
entries.answerEnglish: Many Roma people live in Europe.

entries.example: 這部電影在講紐約貧民區的故事。
entries.exampleEnglish: This movie tells a story set in a New York ghetto.
entries.question: 很多大城市都有貧民區嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do many big cities have ghettos?
entries.answer: 對，很多大城市都有貧民區。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, many big cities have ghettos.

entries.example: 台灣有很多美麗的小鄉鎮。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan has many beautiful small towns.
entries.question: 你最喜歡台灣哪個鄉鎮？
entries.questionEnglish: Which township in Taiwan do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡宜蘭的一個小鄉鎮。
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite is a small town in Yilan.

entries.example: 幾家大公司組成卡特爾，一起控制價格。
entries.exampleEnglish: Several big companies formed a cartel to control prices together.
entries.question: 卡特爾對消費者有什麼影響？
entries.questionEnglish: How do cartels affect consumers?
entries.answer: 卡特爾會讓商品的價格變貴。
entries.answerEnglish: Cartels make goods more expensive.

entries.example: 這個新產品被媒體炒作得很紅。
entries.exampleEnglish: The media hyped this new product into a big hit.
entries.question: 你覺得很多新聞都在炒作嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think a lot of news is just hype?
entries.answer: 對，很多新聞只是在炒作話題。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a lot of news is just hyping up topics.

entries.example: 美國是世界上的超級大國。
entries.exampleEnglish: The United States is a world superpower.
entries.question: 你覺得哪些國家是超級大國？
entries.questionEnglish: Which countries do you think are superpowers?
entries.answer: 我覺得美國是最大的超級大國。
entries.answerEnglish: I think the US is the biggest superpower.

entries.example: 法西斯主義在二戰以後失去了影響力。
entries.exampleEnglish: Fascism lost its influence after World War II.
entries.question: 法西斯主義出現在哪個時代？
entries.questionEnglish: In what era did fascism appear?
entries.answer: 法西斯主義主要出現在二十世紀初。
entries.answerEnglish: Fascism mainly appeared in the early twentieth century.

entries.example: 總統夫人今天去逛了夜市。
entries.exampleEnglish: The First Lady visited a night market today.
entries.question: 你在新聞上看過總統夫人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen the First Lady on the news?
entries.answer: 看過，總統夫人常常陪總統出國。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the First Lady often travels abroad with the President.

entries.example: 聖誕節的時候，她喝了一杯雪利酒。
entries.exampleEnglish: At Christmas, she had a glass of sherry.
entries.question: 你喝過雪利酒嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had sherry?
entries.answer: 喝過，雪利酒喝起來有一點甜。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, sherry tastes a little sweet.

entries.example: 他今天是替補，沒有上場。
entries.exampleEnglish: He was a substitute today and didn't play.
entries.question: 你在球隊裡當過替補嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been a substitute on a team?
entries.answer: 當過，我以前常常當替補球員。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I used to be a substitute player a lot.

entries.example: 這個抽屜是上鎖的，打不開。
entries.exampleEnglish: This drawer is locked; it won't open.
entries.question: 你出門時一定會把門上鎖嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you always lock the door when you go out?
entries.answer: 會，我出門一定會把門上鎖。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always lock the door when I go out.

entries.example: 她喜歡穿顏色鮮豔的衣服。
entries.exampleEnglish: She likes wearing brightly colored clothes.
entries.question: 你喜歡穿顏色鮮豔的衣服嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like wearing brightly colored clothes?
entries.answer: 喜歡，鮮豔的衣服讓我心情很好。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, bright clothes put me in a good mood.

entries.english: charter a car; hire a car with driver
entries.example: 我們包車去九份玩了一天。
entries.exampleEnglish: We chartered a car and spent a day in Jiufen.
entries.question: 你出去玩時喜歡包車嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like chartering a car when you go on trips?
entries.answer: 喜歡，人多的時候包車比較方便。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, chartering a car is more convenient when there are a lot of us.

entries.example: 這本書在講一個法西斯主義者的一生。
entries.exampleEnglish: This book tells the life story of a fascist.
entries.question: 歷史上有名的法西斯主義者是誰？
entries.questionEnglish: Who is a famous fascist in history?
entries.answer: 墨索里尼是很有名的法西斯主義者。
entries.answerEnglish: Mussolini is a very well-known fascist.

entries.example: 動物園裡的企鵝好可愛。
entries.exampleEnglish: The penguins at the zoo are so cute.
entries.question: 你在哪裡看過企鵝？
entries.questionEnglish: Where have you seen penguins?
entries.answer: 我在台北動物園看過企鵝。
entries.answerEnglish: I've seen penguins at the Taipei Zoo.

entries.example: 我幫你預留了一個靠窗的位子。
entries.exampleEnglish: I saved you a window seat.
entries.question: 你每個月會預留一些錢存起來嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you set aside some money to save every month?
entries.answer: 會，我每個月預留三千塊存起來。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I set aside three thousand dollars to save every month.

entries.example: 這台貨車滿載著西瓜。
entries.exampleEnglish: This truck is fully loaded with watermelons.
entries.question: 你逛夜市常常滿載而歸嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often come home from night markets loaded with stuff?
entries.answer: 對，我每次去夜市都滿載而歸。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I come home loaded with stuff every time I go to a night market.

entries.example: 我不小心撞到了桌子。
entries.exampleEnglish: I accidentally bumped into the table.
entries.question: 你走路看手機會撞到人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you bump into people when you look at your phone while walking?
entries.answer: 有時候會，我上次撞到一根柱子。
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. Last time I walked into a pillar.

entries.example: 因為下大雨，比賽要重賽。
entries.exampleEnglish: Because of the heavy rain, the game has to be replayed.
entries.question: 比賽什麼時候需要重賽？
entries.questionEnglish: When does a game need to be replayed?
entries.answer: 天氣太差時，比賽可能要重賽。
entries.answerEnglish: When the weather is too bad, a game may need to be replayed.

entries.example: 他是我們公司足球隊的守門員。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's the goalkeeper on our company's soccer team.
entries.question: 你踢足球時當過守門員嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever played goalkeeper in soccer?
entries.answer: 當過，但我當守門員常常被進球。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but when I'm goalie I let in a lot of goals.

entries.english: connected to the internet; go online
entries.example: 這台冰箱可以連網。
entries.exampleEnglish: This fridge can connect to the internet.
entries.question: 你家有哪些東西可以連網？
entries.questionEnglish: What things in your home can connect to the internet?
entries.answer: 我家的電視和冷氣都可以連網。
entries.answerEnglish: The TV and air conditioner at my place can both go online.

entries.example: 警察在路口取締違規停車。
entries.exampleEnglish: Police are cracking down on illegal parking at the intersection.
entries.question: 警察常常取締什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do the police often crack down on?
entries.answer: 警察常常取締酒駕和違規停車。
entries.answerEnglish: The police often crack down on drunk driving and illegal parking.

entries.example: 我在一家電信公司上班。
entries.exampleEnglish: I work for a telecom company.
entries.question: 你的手機用哪家電信？
entries.questionEnglish: Which telecom company does your phone use?
entries.answer: 我用中華電信。
entries.answerEnglish: I use Chunghwa Telecom.

entries.example: 這個架子不牢靠，不要放太重的東西。
entries.exampleEnglish: This shelf isn't secure, so don't put heavy things on it.
entries.question: 你家有不牢靠的家具嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any wobbly furniture at home?
entries.answer: 有，我房間的椅子有點不牢靠。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the chair in my room is a bit wobbly.

entries.example: 最近很多年輕人開始聽黑膠。
entries.exampleEnglish: Lately a lot of young people have started listening to vinyl.
entries.question: 你喜歡黑膠的聲音嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like the sound of vinyl?
entries.answer: 喜歡，黑膠的聲音很溫暖。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, vinyl has a warm sound.

entries.example: 我們把錢分散在不同的銀行。
entries.exampleEnglish: We spread our money across different banks.
entries.question: 你會把錢分散投資嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you spread your money across different investments?
entries.answer: 會，我把錢分散在股票和定存。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I spread my money between stocks and fixed deposits.

entries.example: 他不太喜歡社交，下班就回家。
entries.exampleEnglish: He doesn't like socializing much; he goes straight home after work.
entries.question: 你喜歡社交還是一個人待著？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer socializing or being on your own?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡社交，常跟朋友出去。
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer socializing; I often go out with friends.

entries.example: 飛機在三萬英尺的高空飛行。
entries.exampleEnglish: The plane is flying at thirty thousand feet.
entries.question: 你的身高大概幾英尺？
entries.questionEnglish: About how many feet tall are you?
entries.answer: 我大概六英尺高。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm about six feet tall.

entries.example: 這塊餅乾是五角形的。
entries.exampleEnglish: This cookie is pentagon-shaped.
entries.question: 你看過五角形的建築嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen a pentagon-shaped building?
entries.answer: 看過，美國的五角大廈就是五角形的。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the Pentagon in the US is pentagon-shaped.

entries.example: 這個杯子是鍍金的，不是真的金子。
entries.exampleEnglish: This cup is gold-plated, not real gold.
entries.question: 你有鍍金的飾品嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any gold-plated jewelry?
entries.answer: 有，我有一條鍍金的項鍊。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a gold-plated necklace.

entries.example: 這是外用藥，不能吃。
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a topical medicine; don't take it by mouth.
entries.question: 外用藥和口服藥有什麼不同？
entries.questionEnglish: What's the difference between topical and oral medicine?
entries.answer: 外用藥是擦在皮膚上的。
entries.answerEnglish: Topical medicine is applied to the skin.

entries.example: 這部電影的原聲帶很好聽。
entries.exampleEnglish: This movie's soundtrack is great.
entries.question: 你喜歡聽電影原聲帶嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like listening to movie soundtracks?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我工作時常聽電影原聲帶。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often listen to movie soundtracks while I work.

entries.example: 日圓貶值了，很多人去日本玩。
entries.exampleEnglish: The yen has fallen, so lots of people are going to Japan.
entries.question: 台幣貶值時，你還會出國嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When the NT dollar is weak, do you still travel abroad?
entries.answer: 比較不會，台幣貶值時出國比較貴。
entries.answerEnglish: Less likely. Traveling abroad is pricier when the NT dollar is weak.

entries.example: 我在澳洲第一次騎馬。
entries.exampleEnglish: I rode a horse for the first time in Australia.
entries.question: 你騎過馬嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever ridden a horse?
entries.answer: 騎過，我在蒙古騎馬騎了三天。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I rode horses for three days in Mongolia.

entries.example: 我最喜歡吃鰻魚飯。
entries.exampleEnglish: Eel rice is my favorite.
entries.question: 你吃過鰻魚嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever eaten eel?
entries.answer: 吃過，日本的鰻魚飯很好吃。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, Japanese eel rice is delicious.

entries.example: 這座老車站已經現代化了。
entries.exampleEnglish: This old train station has been modernized.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣哪個城市最現代化？
entries.questionEnglish: Which city in Taiwan do you think is the most modern?
entries.answer: 我覺得台北最現代化。
entries.answerEnglish: I think Taipei is the most modern.

entries.example: 冷氣壞了，維修人員下午會來。
entries.exampleEnglish: The AC broke; the repairman is coming this afternoon.
entries.question: 家裡東西壞了，你會找維修人員嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When something at home breaks, do you call a repairman?
entries.answer: 會，我會打電話請維修人員來修。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'll call a repairman to come fix it.

entries.example: 很多電影都在講黑手黨的故事。
entries.exampleEnglish: Lots of movies tell stories about the mafia.
entries.question: 黑手黨最早出現在哪個國家？
entries.questionEnglish: In which country did the mafia first appear?
entries.answer: 黑手黨最早出現在義大利。
entries.answerEnglish: The mafia first appeared in Italy.

entries.example: 政府宣布內閣要改組。
entries.exampleEnglish: The government announced a cabinet reshuffle.
entries.question: 你的公司最近有改組嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has your company been reorganized recently?
entries.answer: 有，去年我們部門改組了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our department was reorganized last year.

entries.example: 捷運上禁止吃東西。
entries.exampleEnglish: Eating is prohibited on the MRT.
entries.question: 你的國家捷運上禁止吃東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is eating banned on the subway in your country?
entries.answer: 沒有禁止，但大家很少在車上吃。
entries.answerEnglish: It's not banned, but people rarely eat on the train.

entries.example: 這支球隊這一季保持不敗。
entries.exampleEnglish: This team stayed unbeaten all season.
entries.question: 你覺得一支球隊能一直不敗嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think a team can stay unbeaten forever?
entries.answer: 很難，沒有球隊能永遠不敗。
entries.answerEnglish: That's hard. No team can stay unbeaten forever.

entries.example: 我的同事是從蘇格蘭來的。
entries.exampleEnglish: My coworker is from Scotland.
entries.question: 你去過蘇格蘭嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to Scotland?
entries.answer: 去過，蘇格蘭的風景很美。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, Scotland's scenery is beautiful.

entries.example: 他在球隊裡踢邊鋒，跑得很快。
entries.exampleEnglish: He plays winger on the team and runs really fast.
entries.question: 踢足球時，你喜歡當邊鋒嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you play soccer, do you like playing winger?
entries.answer: 喜歡，當邊鋒可以一直跑來跑去。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, as a winger you get to run around all the time.

entries.example: 樹上有一隻小鳥在唱歌。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a little bird singing in the tree.
entries.question: 你家附近有很多小鳥嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there lots of birds near your home?
entries.answer: 有，每天早上都有小鳥在叫。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, birds chirp every morning.

entries.example: 這位打者今天打了兩支全壘打。
entries.exampleEnglish: This batter hit two home runs today.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪位棒球打者？
entries.questionEnglish: Who's your favorite baseball batter?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡大谷翔平這位打者。
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite batter is Shohei Ohtani.

entries.example: 兩個國家已經交戰了很多年。
entries.exampleEnglish: The two countries have been at war for many years.
entries.question: 交戰的國家要怎麼停火？
entries.questionEnglish: How can warring countries reach a ceasefire?
entries.answer: 交戰的國家可以坐下來談判。
entries.answerEnglish: Warring countries can sit down and negotiate.

entries.example: 垃圾放太久，裡面長了蛆。
entries.exampleEnglish: The garbage was left too long and got maggots.
entries.question: 怎麼做垃圾才不會長蛆？
entries.questionEnglish: What can you do so your garbage doesn't get maggots?
entries.answer: 垃圾要每天丟，才不會長蛆。
entries.answerEnglish: Take out the trash every day so it doesn't get maggots.

entries.example: 這筆交易已經完成了。
entries.exampleEnglish: This deal has been completed.
entries.question: 你常在網路上做二手交易嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often make secondhand deals online?
entries.answer: 常常，我在網路上做過很多二手交易。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I've done lots of secondhand deals online.

entries.example: 窗戶沒關好，一直有冷風吹進來。
entries.exampleEnglish: The window isn't shut properly, so cold air keeps coming in.
entries.question: 冬天你怕冷風嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you mind the cold wind in winter?
entries.answer: 很怕，我出門一定戴圍巾擋冷風。
entries.answerEnglish: Very much. I always wear a scarf to keep out the cold wind.

entries.example: 他是一名職業足球員。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a professional soccer player.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪位足球員？
entries.questionEnglish: Who's your favorite soccer player?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡梅西這位足球員。
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite soccer player is Messi.

entries.example: 他們贏了資格賽，可以參加世界盃。
entries.exampleEnglish: They won the qualifier and can play in the World Cup.
entries.question: 你看過世界盃的資格賽嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you watched a World Cup qualifier?
entries.answer: 看過，資格賽也很精彩。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the qualifiers are exciting too.

entries.example: 這個地區有一些分離主義者。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are some separatists in this region.
entries.question: 分離主義者通常想要什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do separatists usually want?
entries.answer: 分離主義者通常想要獨立。
entries.answerEnglish: Separatists usually want independence.

entries.example: 大雨讓很多遊客受困在山上。
entries.exampleEnglish: The heavy rain left many tourists stranded in the mountains.
entries.question: 受困在電梯裡時應該怎麼做？
entries.questionEnglish: What should you do if you're trapped in an elevator?
entries.answer: 受困在電梯裡要按緊急按鈕。
entries.answerEnglish: If you're trapped in an elevator, press the emergency button.

entries.example: 她每週去做一次心理治療。
entries.exampleEnglish: She goes to therapy once a week.
entries.question: 想做心理治療可以去哪裡？
entries.questionEnglish: Where can you go if you want psychotherapy?
entries.answer: 可以去醫院的身心科做心理治療。
entries.answerEnglish: You can go to a hospital's psychiatry department for therapy.

entries.example: 杜拜的酋長非常有錢。
entries.exampleEnglish: The sheikh of Dubai is extremely rich.
entries.question: 你在新聞上看過酋長嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen a sheikh on the news?
entries.answer: 看過，新聞常報導中東的酋長。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the news often reports on Middle Eastern sheikhs.

entries.example: 小貓藏身在沙發下面。
entries.exampleEnglish: The kitten is hiding under the sofa.
entries.question: 小時候玩捉迷藏，你喜歡藏身在哪裡？
entries.questionEnglish: When you played hide-and-seek as a kid, where did you like to hide?
entries.answer: 我喜歡藏身在衣櫃裡。
entries.answerEnglish: I liked hiding in the wardrobe.

entries.example: 這家店專門賣二手黑膠唱片。
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop specializes in secondhand vinyl records.
entries.question: 你家裡有黑膠唱片嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any vinyl records at home?
entries.answer: 有，我有幾張爸爸以前買的黑膠唱片。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a few records my dad bought years ago.

entries.example: 這家酒吧晚上會放雷鬼樂。
entries.exampleEnglish: This bar plays reggae at night.
entries.question: 你喜歡聽雷鬼樂嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like listening to reggae?
entries.answer: 喜歡，雷鬼樂聽起來很輕鬆。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, reggae sounds really relaxing.

entries.example: 這部獨立電影在影展得了獎。
entries.exampleEnglish: This indie film won an award at a film festival.
entries.question: 你喜歡看獨立電影嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like watching indie films?
entries.answer: 喜歡，獨立電影的故事比較特別。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, indie films have more unusual stories.

entries.example: 他是這份工作無庸置疑的最佳人選。
entries.exampleEnglish: He is undoubtedly the best person for this job.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼事是無庸置疑的？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is beyond doubt?
entries.answer: 健康最重要，這是無庸置疑的。
entries.answerEnglish: Health matters most; that's beyond doubt.
